model.name: Model for RAAS system of blood pressure regulation.

notes.body:
Model for RAAS system of blood pressure regulation.
version 3
Renin cleaves angiotensinogen to angiotensin I, ACE converts angiotensin I to angiotensin II. Angiotensin II acts on the AT1 receptors, which E3174 blocks (fe_e3174, the fraction of blocked receptors): the AT1 signal f_at1 is the angiotensin II relative to its baseline times the fraction of free receptors. The AT1 signal drives the secretion of aldosterone, inhibits the secretion of renin (short loop feedback, RENSEC_n) and raises the blood pressure (BP_emax). The turnover of renin, aldosterone and the angiotensins is given by their half-lives in plasma (renin 15 min, aldosterone 20 min, angiotensin I 0.5 min and angiotensin II 0.4 min); the concentrations do not depend on the volume of the compartment. The baselines (*_ref) are steady states, the initial concentrations are the baselines (initial assignments), which the experiments set per study.

The E3174 of plasma at which half of the AT1 receptors are blocked. Fitted to the renin, angiotensin II and aldosterone of the PD data: a blockade of 0.83 at the peak and 0.09 at 24 hr after 100 mg losartan. The inhibition of the pressor response to angiotensin II is about 0.85 at the peak and 0.25-0.40 at 24 hr [FDA label]; the E3174 of the model falls faster than measured (terminal half-life 3.4 hr against 6.3 hr [Lo1995]).
The value of E50_e3174 is the result of the fit PD_20261019_134029__a3a50, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: feedback of the AT1 signal on the renin secretion

body.p: The renin secretion is the AT1 signal to the power -RENSEC_n (the short loop feedback of angiotensin II on the juxtaglomerular cells). In the steady state renin and angiotensin II rise by (1 - fe)^(-n/(1+n)) and the AT1 signal and aldosterone fall to (1 - fe)^(1/(1+n)): PRA x2-3 and aldosterone -20 to -40 % at the peak of 50-100 mg losartan.
The value of RENSEC_n is the result of the fit PD_20261019_134029__a3a50, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: maximal fractional fall of the blood pressure

body.p: The fall of the blood pressure relative to its baseline at the complete loss of the AT1 signal (vasoconstriction, sodium retention). Fitted, but not identified by the blood pressure of the data: -7 mmHg of the diastolic blood pressure at the peak of 100 mg losartan (-6 to -10 mmHg in hypertension [FDA label]).
The value of BP_emax is the result of the fit PD_20261019_134029__a3a50, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

AT1 signal relative to the baseline

body.p: Angiotensin II relative to its baseline times the fraction of the AT1 receptors which E3174 does not block; 1 at the baseline.
Angiotensin II inhibits the secretion of renin via AT1 (short loop feedback); the blockade of AT1 by E3174 removes the inhibition.
Angiotensin II drives the secretion of aldosterone via AT1 receptors of the adrenal cortex; E3174 blocks the receptors.
